import numpy as np
n=3
i=np.arange(n,dtype=float)
angle=2*np.pi*i/n
lumped_mass=(i+2)/np.sum(i+2)
node_scale=.8+.13*i
K=np.zeros((n,n))
for row in range(n):
    K[row,(row+1)%n]+=.25
    K[(row+1)%n,row]-=.25
D=K/lumped_mass[:,None]
cross_x=np.array([[0.,0.,0.],[0.,0.,-1.],[0.,1.,0.]])
source_curl=np.kron(D,cross_x)
magnetic_nodes=np.array([np.column_stack((.4+.05*np.cos(angle),.28*np.cos(angle)+.12*np.sin(angle),.22*np.sin(angle)-.09*np.cos(angle)))])
velocity=np.array([np.column_stack((.13*np.sin(angle),.19*np.cos(angle)+.05,.12*np.sin(angle+.3)))])
density=np.array([.75])
background_field=np.array([.4])
ion_skin_depth=np.array([0.6])
physical_resistivity=np.array([.18])
wavenumber=np.array([2.3])
internal_energy=np.array([.4+.025*i])
residual_load=lumped_mass[None,:,None]*np.array([np.column_stack((.03+.01*i,.015*np.cos(angle),.02*np.sin(angle)))])
candidates=np.array([[.16,.20],[.12,.12],[.09,.07],[.06,.03]])
permeability=1.0
amplitude_limit=.15
phase_limit=.15
log_damping_limit=.15
heat_fraction_limit=.12
b6_margin_min=.06
c_low=.25
c_res=1.0
heat_fraction_limit=.012
current_load=lumped_mass[None,:,None]*np.array([(source_curl@h.ravel()).reshape(n,3) for h in magnetic_nodes])
assert np.allclose(hall_mhd_paper_design(candidates,density,background_field,ion_skin_depth,physical_resistivity,wavenumber,velocity,current_load,lumped_mass,magnetic_nodes,residual_load,node_scale,internal_energy,permeability=permeability,amplitude_limit=amplitude_limit,phase_limit=phase_limit,log_damping_limit=log_damping_limit,heat_fraction_limit=heat_fraction_limit,b6_margin_min=b6_margin_min,c_low=c_low,c_res=c_res,source_curl=source_curl), target)
